reviews.comment: Dr. Foote is an amazing professor. Although this class is very lecture heavy her lecture style is very narrative. Often when class was over I was disappointed that the story had to be stopped. There are only a few grades (weekly quizzes, a midterm, and a final) but she allows you to prepare for these with a cheat sheet.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Foote is one of my favorite professors at Texas A&M. She genuinely cares about her students and is very understanding. She encourages class discussions, which makes the material more engaging and meaningful. The coursework is manageable and well-structured. I highly recommend her — she's one of the best professors here.

Dr.Foote was amazing, her lectures were all incredible and the class was entertaining. Her tests are a little hard since there are so many terms but she allows a page of notes and as long as you go to class and take decent notes you should be fine. Just be sure to not rely on the lecture slides entirely as some terms are only mentioned in person.

I adore Dr. Foote with my whole being. Her class solidified my drive to teach history someday. She is inspirational and flexible as well as evidently intelligent/experienced. She made each day enjoyable and fulfilling. If you need a HIST-280, this is the woman you want teaching said course. My favorite writing intensive course ever; I loved it!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
I couldn't have asked for a more involved and interested professor who really pulls you into her lectures and makes that 75 minutes feel like half an hour. There's going to be quite a bit of reading, I will admit, but they're interesting and not very long books, and you're given plenty of time.
Also, you can take two pages of notes for your exams.
Show up to class and you'll make an A, almost everything on the exams she goes over in class and the required readings are awesome.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Literally just show up to class, take some good notes, put a little effort into the homework essays, and you'll get an A. She and John Lewis (the TA), are extremely chill if you need to miss class (if you have proof), they spice up the class sometimes, not too tough on grading. VERY lecture/note heavy, wouldn't recommend if you're slow at typing.

She cares about students and cares about the material she teaches. Her lecture slides are clear and easy to take notes on. There are a small number of grades in the grade book and there's no regular homework in this class so make sure to take good notes and study them for the tests and quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great Professor, She keeps the lectures very entertaining, gives out study guides for every exam/assignment that is exactly what you see on the assignment. However, the TA is terrible his grading is extremely hard for a class that should be relatively easy. You can put everything he claims he looks for into an assignment still lose a lot of points.

ok so the professor herself is amazing, she is passionate and the lectures are never boring, they are really interesting, however, if you are a science major #no, the TA grades so specifically it's insane, he grades down to the T, like he does not grade lightly at all, it's unnecessary. amazing prof = eh TA. everything is through him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took her because of her good reviews but she was really tough and difficult for someone who doesn't even care about history. She'll make you write papers that are so specific I never knew what the right way was. She also makes you read so much material.

I was really nervous for this class but Dr. Foote made it wonderful. She is super knowledgeable, and I learned so much! This class is super interesting. Expectations are clear and it's work but totally doable. As long as you read, you're so solid. Dr. Foote really makes this class. She is amazing. Fun stories and super interesting

She is legitimately my favorite professor at Texas A&M. I would take her at all costs. You will do some work, but she makes everything worthwhile. Amazing professor. I learned so much, and she reignited my passion for history.

I graduated one year ago and created a RMP account just so I could leave this review. She is a professor that I will never forget for many reasons. She is truly one of the best professors I ever had at A&M, and she made the class incredibly enjoyable. I learned something new every time we had class, and she was very passionate about the topic.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very lecture heavy but very doable. She gives study guides for her exams that you can use which help. This course in an easy A if you put in the work.

Go to lectures. The exams are lecture based, she lets you make a study guide to take with you on the exams. Chapter quizzes aren't too bad, the readings can be long so don't procrastinate on them. She brings her dog to class sometimes, overall she is a great professor and made what can be a boring class really interesting.

I absolutely love this woman! I have never been a big fan of history classes but this ended up being my favorite class of the semester! She is truly one of the most intelligent, well spoken people I've ever met. Every lecture was super engaging and I feel like I learned so much. Take in-depth notes for the reading quizzes!!!

Dr. Foote is an amazing professor and you can easily get an A in her class if you put in some effort. There are readings of about 30 pages with a semi-difficult quiz weekly and two exams. Although attendance is not mandatory you NEED to take notes in class if you want to pass. Try to make friends in the class that can fill you in if you miss a day
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor by far!!!! She is very engaging you can tell she cares about what she teaches. Her TA's Maddie and Regan are amazing and are always willing to help. Lectures are crucial to remotely passing the class. Be ready for reading chapters and taking quizzes over them. If you go to class and do the assignments you will be fine!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very engaging Professor, teaches with a passion. Has great TAs, Maddie and Reagan. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you want to actually learn and pass attendance is mandatory. A lot of participation activities, and very engaging in class, funny and a fun professor. She is very nice and understanding, you get what you put in!

I've now taken Dr. Foote for 280, 230, and 443. I CANNOT recommend her more strongly. Her lectures, discussion, and feedback are so worth your time, and her chosen readings are genuinely interesting, if time consuming. You can tell she cares about everyone (learned everyone's names in all of my classes!) and is passionate about her subjects.

Dr. Foote is one of my favorite profs I've ever had. She is so caring and funny and makes history fun again. If you don't show up to class you probably won't understand what's going on, but she makes it easy to keep up in class. She genuinely cares about her students and gets to know them by name. She lets us form our own connections and thoughts.

Professor Foote provides great, engaging lectures. However, her classwork is graded very tough. The quizzes are 5 questions, very detailed specific to the 40 page readings. You have 5 minutes for the quizzes and they are relatively difficult due to the crunch on time. Would have enjoyed the class more if assignments weren't graded so hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 10/10 would recommend Dr. Foote, she is an amazing lecturer and I genuinely looked forward to attending class. The class was lecture heavy but they were always entertaining and engaging. We had very few grades throughout the semester which meant week to week workload was light but tests/quizzes were important. Easily my favorite professor I've had.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I LOVE DR. FOOTE!! She cares about her student and wants you to succeed. She is mindful of outside circumstances and takes that into account when working with you. She is always open to answer questions and to help guide her students towards success. I learned so much from her and she is 100% one of my favorite professors at TAMU.

Professor Foote made me more interested in military history! She gave excellent lectures and I never checked the clock during class. You should go to her class every day as her tests are open-note and the power points she posts don't include the lecture. She was probably my favorite professor at A&M so far.
Awesome Professor! Would definitely take again! Need more Professor's like her!

She is an amazing Prof.  She keeps her lectures entertaining and is always taking questions. There are not a whole lot of assignments, two books you have to read, a midterm, and one or two other assignments.  Pretty easy to get a good grade if you follow the instructions she puts on the assignments.

The class attendance rate was the highest of any class I have seen.  She always stopped to answer questions and she would invite students to contribute to the discussion.  She cared to see the class develop an appreciation of the subject as opposed to expecting the class to just memorize a bunch of material.

Dr. Foote is very passionate about what she teaches. Because of this, she puts tons of energy and enthusiasm into her lectures. Her lectures are clear and are organized well along a very thorough historical timeline of US History. I did find attentiveness mandatory in doing well, but she makes it interesting. I would recommend.

The best professor I have ever had in my college career. I would take this class again if it meant I could have her as a teacher. This class was also incredible and you can make an easy A if you just do the work.

Dr. Foote is great! You really are learning from someone that knows her stuff. She is well-respected in the history community. Great guest speakers. She teaches you how to research and build up a paper. She is kind and honest. Her book could be a hit HBO series one day and she could be cashing big checks... until then she is teaching us.

Professor Foote is an absolute gem; she's a brilliant and outstanding professor. Don't shy away from taking her class just because it requires extensive research and reading. An A is incredibly attainable through showing her proper effort and work. Also, she will teach you how to improve your writing style and motivate you to propel in academia.

This woman is brilliant and gives incredible lectures! If you have to take HIST 280 take it with Foote!! It's not an easy A but very attainable if you show you're putting in the work. A good amount of reading and a lot of writing and research. She's so kind and caring for her students. I'm going to try and take as many classes as I can from her!!

Although her TAs graded most of our papers, she is an excellent professor who passionately lectures. She had quizzes on the textbook chapters which can definitely sting if you didn't read, but if you take notes and listen to her lectures, you'll definitely pass. The best part? You can use notes on the midterm and final.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Foote is an amazing professor! She engaged with students before and during class. She was extremely clear, passionate, and informative in each lecture. The tests are essays and as long as you pay attention in class, you'll do well. She cares about her students and wants everyone to learn the material. TAKE HER!!

Professor Foote is amazing. Her lectures are interesting, and she cares about her students. She is good at communicating the information in a manner that is easy to follow. I never liked history, but she made me like it more. If you have the chance, I definitely recommend taking Professor Foote
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Foote makes history fun. Talk in class and she'll like you. Don't miss lecture, you won't be able to get the information later. She is super nice and cares about her students' lives.

Dr. Foote has been one of my favorite profs. She wants the best for her students and truly cares. There are only 2 exams (midterm and final) but there are several quizzes. Youll have to read a book but it was so interesting. I would 10/10 recommend taking her!!!
She has the greatest lectures of all time!

Dr. Foote clearly loves what she is teaching. Lectures are normally not hard to follow. She has slides with a very clear outline of the lectures, but doesn't post them. Course is about 85% essay based, so be ready for that. Exams are HEAVILY based on lecture (and all free response), so go to class everyday. She allows one page of notes on exams.

Dr. Lorien is AMAZING!! She is so kind to her students, and genuinely cares about her students lives in and out of the classroom. There is a lot of reading and writing, however if you turn everything in on time and do all your work you will be just fine in the class! No tests. If you are willing to do the work, you will have A in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of my favorite. Genuinely enjoyed all of her lectures. Decent amount of work but nothing too difficult. Would take again!!

She is a great professor and really wants to see her students succeed! She is always available to help students. This was a writing intensive class and it required a lot of work but Dr. Foote was there to help us all along the way.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing professor and with equally amazing lectures. She is very helpful outside of class and is willing the help you with whatever you need. Good amount of reading but its all about time management. You get what you put in.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Foote was one of the great professors I have ever had. While her class had some work, it was nothing that could not be managed. She is inspirational and her lectures were amazing and always interesting. She cares so much about you and the class and if you try and know what you're talking about, she grades fairly. AMAZING prof!

Dr Foote was an amazing professor! I recommend taking her for the required historians craft writing seminar because she teaches you how to develop your own style and teaches how to do accurate and informative interpretations and research methods. Class participation was graded but she would work with you if you had conflicts or work;10/10 reccomend

Foote loves her job and has mastered teaching this curriculum. At first I was very discouraged because the grading is very rough and all assignments (although there aren't many) required a lot of preparation. But she is an interesting lecturer, nice person, and she wants you to succeed as long as you put in the work.

Dr. Foote is passionate about what she teaches and very intriguing in her lectures. Extremely kind & relatable, making her students want to do well for her. Not the easiest A (she has the TA grade hard) but if you put in effort you can do well. This class taught me how to study & write and I developed habits I'll take with me throughout college.

Dr. Foote changed my whole perspective on college in general. She is passionate about what she does and will teach you how to be a student, and a scholar. Lectures are presented in a passionate way and she is always open outside of class. She wants you to succeed.

Dr. Foote is a really great professor but don't take her if you want an easy A. There is only a midterm and a final and they are completely written out which is difficult to prepare for. I worked really hard for this class but still made a C because of the assignments. Her class sparked my interest for history, but brought down my GPA.

She is so passionate! I loved going to her lectures just to hear her. She is funny and engaging. I took her class my first semester freshman year and her expectations for writing assignments were higher than I expected, but if you make a half-ass effort studying and go to class, which is not hard, an A is achievable.

You can tell she really cares about history and that makes her lectures interesting and enjoyable. The information is entirely lecture based so if you don't go to class, you will fail the class. Her tests are essay based and she grades fairly difficult (I got points off for not capitalizing a word) but they're not impossible if you study.

I worked my butt off in this class and I still made a C. I really enjoyed lectures because she is so inspiring and loves her job but when it comes to grading don't get your hopes up. There is no curve at anytime, no extra credit and her tests are crap to study for because you have to know everything for a short test that isn't even multiple choice.

Her class is essay based, with essay quizzes and tests. If you study you will get the A. She is a dynamic speaker and teaches history is terms of stories not dates. There was no date memorizing or time lines, I highly recommend her! She loves what she's doing and makes you love it too!

It's very obvious that she absolutely loves history, and loves teaching it just as much. She doesn't put her notes online so you have to either take them yourself or have a friend send them to you. I never got bored in her class and if I had to take History 106 I would definitely take Foote again!

Dr. Foote is so passionate about history which makes her lectures really interesting. She is a story teller so the class isn't about boring history because she is energetic! She has 1 assignment, 1 quiz and 1 test for each half semester. (So two of each total) I would have to say the one bad thing is she doesn't post lectures online so go to class!

Her lectures are very interesting! She knows her stuff and is excited about history. She assigned three books, gave reading quizzes, and made two writing assignments. The only tests were the midterm and the final. Her TA did the grading and was  tough. She would take points off on the writing assignments and exams and not give a good reason why.

Dr. Foote's class was a great start for getting used to the difficulty of college classes. If you go to all of the lectures, take good notes, and study hard the tests will make you happy. If you read all the books and actually take away the important information from them the quizzes will be easy as well. Not a walk in the park but very manageable.

Dr. Foote's lectures are great and easy to understand, she has an obvious passion for history so she makes it interesting. Only downfall to this class is you have to go and take good notes, and read several books for quizzes. She's one of the best professors I've ever had as far as actual teaching abilities go, I'd definitely take her again.

Dr. Foote makes history very interesting by including fun stories and explaining things with details that make them make more sense. Since there is no textbook, attendance is crucial but it is not a boring class at all. Her grading is tough, but doable. I feel like I have actually learned and retained what she taught our class. She rocks!
I loved her lectures, she gets really into it.

She loves her subject, so her lectures are very engaging. Her passion for history is infectious and I started her class not enjoying history and now I love it. She balances out her tests with a few quizzes and assignments, but those are both easy and she tells you exactly what will be asked on them.
